purpose: Descriptive inference cost for fixed new selected checkpoints; no energy, GPU, streaming-token, KV-cache, SNN or Transformer result
registration_timing: May occur while formal training is running; must precede validation/test scoring and runtime execution

scope.checkpoint_source: Already sealed validation selection; benchmark every eligible identity regardless of observed task quality

execution.unit: Fresh-reset full 32-tick sequence forward, with production prepare_sequence and initial-state creation inside every timed call
execution.model_and_inputs: Loaded before timing; no disk I/O, checkpoint loading or quality evaluation inside timed intervals
execution.case: Each physical checkpoint at each registered batch size
execution.warmup_order: A fresh permutation of all case IDs per warmup round, NumPy default_rng seed 20261029
execution.timed_order: A fresh permutation of all case IDs per timed round, NumPy default_rng seed 20261030
execution.output_check: CPU return is synchronous; after each timed call, verify finite output and bitwise output digest against its warmed deterministic result; validation time excluded
start_conditions: All 60 formal training candidates are sealed complete
Registered checkpoint precision appendix is complete, with failures retained
Root schedules the run on idle CPU and explicitly records that scheduling assertion
execution.idle_cpu_claim: Scheduling assertion plus raw CPU/wall samples, not a claim to control unrelated host processes
execution.reuse: No model, endpoint, repetition or case is omitted or reselected according to accuracy, CE or measured time

summaries.interpretation: Repeated timing samples describe one CPU execution environment and one timed training seed; they are not independent training seeds

state_accounting.float_payload: Counted recurrent float scalars times actual model dtype element size
state_accounting.discrete_payload: Use actual accounting dtypes: two int64 counters and one bool flag
state_accounting.batch_payload: Per-episode scalar payload multiplied by batch size
state_accounting.scope: Counted recurrent state payload inside this full-sequence implementation; excludes inputs, outputs, temporary activations, Python objects, allocator overhead and model weights
state_accounting.prohibited_inference: Not a measured peak-memory result and not an implemented streaming/KV-cache API

quality_join.stage: Separate join after immutable primary held-out scores exist; it does not influence the measurement matrix
quality_join.label: empirical_quality_band_eligible
quality_join.meaning: A narrow descriptive band on the observed scores of the two timed selected models, not a statistical equivalence test or proof of equal population quality
quality_join.if_ineligible: Keep every raw timing case and score; do not report a matched-quality cost ratio for that pair
quality_join.if_eligible: Report analytic/comparator median CPU and wall cost ratios for both registered batch sizes, with individual summaries and observed score gaps
limitations: No extrapolation to other seeds, hardware, long contexts or modalities
Frozen-flow is a controller-freezing diagnostic with different trainable parameter count
No SNN/Transformer comparison or energy conclusion

artifacts: fixed training input shards and hashes
